note: Pinned inputs for Riftway's runtime build. Recall's own scripts pin and verify the Wine, DXMT and dependency sources; this file pins Recall itself and the toolchains it expects.

source_date_epoch.note: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for every build: lld writes it as the PE TimeDateStamp of Wine's and DXMT's modules (header and export table) instead of the build time.

llvm-15.sha256_source: GitHub publishes no digest for this release; pinned from the first download on 2026-10-13 after checking its size against the release asset

python-x86_64.interpreter: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/python3 under Rosetta (arch -x86_64), so meson targets x86_64 natively

apple.note: Apple's tools are not downloaded by the build; these are the ones a reproducible build needs (the GitHub Actions macos-26 arm64 image has both). Everything except DXMT's shaders builds with the Command Line Tools and their SDK.

metal.note: DXMT's shaders (metal, metallib) through Recall's portable_metal.py, from this Xcode with its Metal Toolchain (xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain); it can sit next to another Xcode

deviations_from_recall: Wine and DXMT are built by Riftway's recipe (runtime/recipe/wine.py and dxmt.py), derived from Recall's build_portable_runtime.py and build_portable_dxmt.py with Recall's patches read from its pinned clone and checked by hash.

No Whisky Libraries.tar.gz: Wine links GnuTLS, inotify and SDL2 from clean-deps (built from source by Recall's build_portable_dependencies.py) and FreeType from runtime/recipe/wine.py's own build (freetype-install), the libraries the runtime ships.

No Soju patches: ncrypt-persisted-keys.patch is GPL-3.0 (Soju's NOTICE offers only winemac-no-dock-icon.patch, whose code wine-v1-canvas.patch carries, under Wine's LGPL-2.1+). Soju's source is only read for the libinotify-kqueue headers (MIT).

No MetalFX: DXMT without dxmt-metalfx-upscaling.patch and with -Denable_nvapi=false -Denable_nvngx=false, so no NVAPI, NGX or D3D12 stand-in and no self-signed nvngx.dll; DXMT's diagnostic programs are not installed.
Binaries map the build workspace to /build/riftway (Recall: /build/overwatch-2-mac).
The --jobs limit of Recall's native dependency script is raised from 4 to 32 in the local clone; it changes build parallelism only, not outputs.

Wine's winegstreamer (Recall builds --without-gstreamer) is built by runtime/media.py in a second Wine tree from the same patched source, against GLib and GStreamer from crossover-sources-26.3.0; decoders are macOS's (applemedia), no FFmpeg.

GStreamer is configured with -Dbuild-tools-source=system (bison from the toolchain, built from source) instead of downloading a prebuilt bison during configure; pcre2 stays static without JIT, as that branch set.
Reproducible: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (source_date_epoch) fixes the PE TimeDateStamp of every module, and runtime/assemble.py derives each Mach-O's LC_UUID from its shipped content.

Apple tools pinned (apple): DXMT builds and links with the Command Line Tools and their SDK like Wine, instead of the selected Xcode, and compiles its shaders with Xcode 26.6's Metal toolchain through a wrapper around Recall's portable_metal.py; the media build runs the pkgconf the native dependencies build, not Homebrew's.

media.note: GLib 2.78.0 and GStreamer 1.24.4 come from crossover-sources-26.3.0 (already pinned by the Wine build). These are the GLib subprojects it fetches; runtime/media.py builds with --wrap-mode=nodownload.
